#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Master Poster Generator.

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering for anti-aliased precision.
Every element meticulously calibrated for museum-grade execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SETUP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

W, H = 3508, 4961  # A1 portrait at 150 DPI

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"

MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=60, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px, py, px+ds, py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def thick_line(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Draw an anti-aliased-ish thick line by drawing a polygon."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if length < 0.5:
        r = width/2
        draw.ellipse([x0-r, y0-r, x0+r, y0+r], fill=fill)
        return
    nx = -dy / length * (width/2)
    ny = dx / length * (width/2)
    corners = [
        (x0+nx, y0+ny), (x1+nx, y1+ny),
        (x1-nx, y1-ny), (x0-nx, y0-ny),
    ]
    draw.polygon([(int(c[0]), int(c[1])) for c in corners], fill=fill)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPER-SAMPLED CHART RENDERING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    """Render chart at scale*x, downsample with LANCZOS for anti-aliasing."""
    sw, sh = int(chart_w * scale), int(chart_h * scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw, sh), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+450, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-32, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(100), BLUE)

y += 118
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(44), WHITE)

y += 62
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+180, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
# Small diamond
cx = MX + 168
draw.polygon([(cx, y+8), (cx+7, y+16), (cx, y+24), (cx-7, y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 75
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90) // 4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx, y, bx+badge_w, y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(38 if len(value) < 9 else 30)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 110


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017–2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 90, 180, 40, 60
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb
SUPERSAMPLE = 2

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    """Draw the language trajectory chart at supersampled resolution."""
    # Chart background
    rr(cdraw, [0, 0, cw, ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid
    for pct in [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70]:
        gy_frac = pct / 70.0
        gy = int((chart_mt + plot_h - gy_frac * plot_h) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([int(chart_ml*scale), gy,
                         int((chart_ml+plot_w)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(22*scale)))
        cdraw.text((int((chart_ml-16)*scale) - tw, gy - int(7*scale)),
                   label, font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # X-axis
    for yr in [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]:
        xf = (yr - 2017) / 7.0
        gx = int((chart_ml + xf * plot_w) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([gx, int(chart_mt*scale),
                         gx+max(1,int(scale)), int((chart_mt+plot_h)*scale)],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(24*scale)))
        cdraw.text((gx - tw//2, int((chart_mt+plot_h+20)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(24*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # Data series
    all_series = [
        # Secondary (behind)
        ([(0,60),(2,61),(4,60),(6,52),(7,51)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,42),(2,56),(4,54),(6,52),(7,48)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,47),(2,50),(4,49),(6,49),(7,46)], "#414868", 2.5, False),
        ([(2,6),(4,8),(6,7),(7,8)],           "#4a3f5e", 2.0, False),
        ([(0,17),(2,20),(4,23),(6,18),(7,17)], "#3b4261", 2.0, False),
        # Primary (on top)
        ([(0,65),(2,69),(4,69),(6,61),(7,61)], BLUE,  5.0, True),
        ([(0,32),(2,49),(4,52),(6,54),(7,57)], AMBER, 4.5, True),
        ([(0,12),(2,25),(4,29),(6,34),(7,37)], MINT,  5.0, True),
    ]

    for data, color, lw, prominent in all_series:
        # Convert to pixel coords
        pts = []
        for yr_idx, val in data:
            xf = yr_idx / 7.0
            px = int((chart_ml + xf * plot_w) * scale)
            py = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (val/70.0)*plot_h) * scale)
            pts.append((px, py))

        slw = int(lw * scale)
        # Draw segments
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            thick_line(cdraw, pts[i][0], pts[i][1], pts[i+1][0], pts[i+1][1], slw, color)

        # Data point dots
        dot_r = slw//2 + int(2*scale)
        for px, py in pts:
            cdraw.ellipse([px-dot_r, py-dot_r, px+dot_r, py+dot_r], fill=color)

    # Legend
    legend_data = [
        ("JavaScript", BLUE,  61, 5.0),
        ("Python",     AMBER, 57, 4.5),
        ("TypeScript", MINT,  37, 5.0),
    ]
    leg_y_start = int((chart_mt + 30) * scale)
    leg_x = int((chart_ml + plot_w + 30) * scale)
    for i, (name, color, final_val, lw) in enumerate(legend_data):
        ly = leg_y_start + i * int(85*scale)
        slw = int(lw*scale)
        # Color swatch line
        cdraw.rectangle([leg_x, ly, leg_x+int(40*scale), ly+slw], fill=color)
        # Name
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly-int(3*scale)),
                   name, font=isb(int(26*scale)), fill=color, anchor="lt")
        # Value
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly+int(24*scale)),
                   f"{final_val}%", font=isr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

chart_img = render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, SUPERSAMPLE, draw_trajectory_chart)
img.paste(chart_img, (MX-10, y-15), chart_img)

y += chart_h + 80


# ── SECTION 3: PROMISE INDEX ─────────────────────────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "03", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "THE LANGUAGE PROMISE INDEX", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+40, "Combining growth, retention & adoption intent to forecast ecosystem direction",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

promise_data = [
    ("TypeScript", 199, MINT),
    ("Rust",       198, CORAL),
    ("Python",     151, AMBER),
    ("Go",         129, BLUE),
    ("Lua",        118, "#787c99"),
    ("C++",        113, "#787c99"),
    ("Kotlin",     113, "#787c99"),
]
bar_left = MX
bar_right = MX + int(CW * 0.62)
bar_h = 48
bar_gap = 18
max_score = 220

for i, (lang, score, color) in enumerate(promise_data):
    by = y + i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
    bar_w = int((score / max_score) * (bar_right - bar_left))
    rr(draw, [bar_left, by, bar_right, by+bar_h], 8, SURFACE)
    if bar_w > 12:
        rr(draw, [bar_left, by, bar_left+bar_w, by+bar_h], 8, color)
    t(draw, bar_left+24, by+bar_h//2-16, lang, jbb(28), BG)
    tr(draw, bar_right-20, by+bar_h//2-16, str(score), jbb(34), color)

# Callout box
cx = bar_right + 70
cw_box = W - MX - cx
rro(draw, [cx, y, cx+cw_box, y+96], 10, SURFACE, MINT, 2)
tml(draw, cx+cw_box//2, y+10, [
    "TypeScript at 199",
    "signals where the",
    "ecosystem is heading —",
    "not just where it's been."
], isb(22), MINT, 4)

y += len(promise_data) * (bar_h + bar_gap) + 100


# ── SECTION 4: DATABASES ─────────────────────────────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "04", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "DATABASES: OPEN-SOURCE DOMINANCE", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "PostgreSQL narrows the gap with MySQL as open-source databases lead",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

db_chart_w = 820
db_chart_h = 440
db_ml, db_mr, db_mt, db_mb = 60, 20, 20, 50

def draw_db_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    rr(cdraw, [0, 0, cw, ch], int(10*scale), SURFACE)

    plot_w_db = db_chart_w - db_ml - db_mr
    plot_h_db = db_chart_h - db_mt - db_mb
    ymax = 65

    for pct in [0, 15, 30, 45, 60]:
        gy = int((db_mt + plot_h_db - (pct/ymax)*plot_h_db) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([int(db_ml*scale), gy,
                         int((db_ml+plot_w_db)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(20*scale)))

        ("MySQL",      [(0,60),(3,52),(5,52)], BLUE,  3.5),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Master Poster Generator.

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering for anti-aliased precision.
Every element meticulously calibrated for museum-grade execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SETUP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

W, H = 3508, 4961  # A1 portrait at 150 DPI

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"

MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=60, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px, py, px+ds, py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def thick_line(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Draw an anti-aliased-ish thick line by drawing a polygon."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if length < 0.5:
        r = width/2
        draw.ellipse([x0-r, y0-r, x0+r, y0+r], fill=fill)
        return
    nx = -dy / length * (width/2)
    ny = dx / length * (width/2)
    corners = [
        (x0+nx, y0+ny), (x1+nx, y1+ny),
        (x1-nx, y1-ny), (x0-nx, y0-ny),
    ]
    draw.polygon([(int(c[0]), int(c[1])) for c in corners], fill=fill)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPER-SAMPLED CHART RENDERING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    """Render chart at scale*x, downsample with LANCZOS for anti-aliasing."""
    sw, sh = int(chart_w * scale), int(chart_h * scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw, sh), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+450, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-32, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(100), BLUE)

y += 118
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(44), WHITE)

y += 62
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+180, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
# Small diamond
cx = MX + 168
draw.polygon([(cx, y+8), (cx+7, y+16), (cx, y+24), (cx-7, y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 75
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90) // 4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx, y, bx+badge_w, y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(38 if len(value) < 9 else 30)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 110


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017–2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 90, 180, 40, 60
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb
SUPERSAMPLE = 2

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    """Draw the language trajectory chart at supersampled resolution."""
    # Chart background
    rr(cdraw, [0, 0, cw, ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid
    for pct in [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70]:
        gy_frac = pct / 70.0
        gy = int((chart_mt + plot_h - gy_frac * plot_h) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([int(chart_ml*scale), gy,
                         int((chart_ml+plot_w)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(22*scale)))
        cdraw.text((int((chart_ml-16)*scale) - tw, gy - int(7*scale)),
                   label, font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # X-axis
    for yr in [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]:
        xf = (yr - 2017) / 7.0
        gx = int((chart_ml + xf * plot_w) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([gx, int(chart_mt*scale),
                         gx+max(1,int(scale)), int((chart_mt+plot_h)*scale)],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(24*scale)))
        cdraw.text((gx - tw//2, int((chart_mt+plot_h+20)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(24*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # Data series
    all_series = [
        # Secondary (behind)
        ([(0,60),(2,61),(4,60),(6,52),(7,51)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,42),(2,56),(4,54),(6,52),(7,48)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,47),(2,50),(4,49),(6,49),(7,46)], "#414868", 2.5, False),
        ([(2,6),(4,8),(6,7),(7,8)],           "#4a3f5e", 2.0, False),
        ([(0,17),(2,20),(4,23),(6,18),(7,17)], "#3b4261", 2.0, False),
        # Primary (on top)
        ([(0,65),(2,69),(4,69),(6,61),(7,61)], BLUE,  5.0, True),
        ([(0,32),(2,49),(4,52),(6,54),(7,57)], AMBER, 4.5, True),
        ([(0,12),(2,25),(4,29),(6,34),(7,37)], MINT,  5.0, True),
    ]

    for data, color, lw, prominent in all_series:
        # Convert to pixel coords
        pts = []
        for yr_idx, val in data:
            xf = yr_idx / 7.0
            px = int((chart_ml + xf * plot_w) * scale)
            py = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (val/70.0)*plot_h) * scale)
            pts.append((px, py))

        slw = int(lw * scale)
        # Draw segments
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            thick_line(cdraw, pts[i][0], pts[i][1], pts[i+1][0], pts[i+1][1], slw, color)

        # Data point dots
        dot_r = slw//2 + int(2*scale)
        for px, py in pts:
            cdraw.ellipse([px-dot_r, py-dot_r, px+dot_r, py+dot_r], fill=color)

    # Legend

        ("JavaScript", BLUE,  61, 5.0),
        ("Python",     AMBER, 57, 4.5),

    ]

    leg_x = int((chart_ml + plot_w + 30) * scale)
    for i, (name, color, final_val, lw) in enumerate(legend_data):
        ly = leg_y_start + i * int(85*scale)
        slw = int(lw*scale)
        # Color swatch line
        cdraw.rectangle([leg_x, ly, leg_x+int(40*scale), ly+slw], fill=color)
        # Name
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly-int(3*scale)),
                   name, font=isb(int(26*scale)), fill=color, anchor="lt")
        # Value
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly+int(24*scale)),
                   f"{final_val}%", font=isr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

chart_img = render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, SUPERSAMPLE, draw_trajectory_chart)
img.paste(chart_img, (MX-10, y-15), chart_img)

y += chart_h + 80

t(draw, MX, y-20, "03", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "THE LANGUAGE PROMISE INDEX", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+40, "Combining growth, retention & adoption intent to forecast ecosystem direction",
  isr(24), DIM)

promise_data = [
    ("TypeScript", 199, MINT),
    ("Rust",       198, CORAL),
    ("Python",     151, AMBER),
    ("Go",         129, BLUE),
    ("Lua",        118, "#787c99"),

    ("Kotlin",     113, "#787c99"),

bar_left = MX

bar_h = 48

max_score = 220

for i, (lang, score, color) in enumerate(promise_data):
    by = y + i * (bar_h + bar_gap)

    rr(draw, [bar_left, by, bar_right, by+bar_h], 8, SURFACE)

    t(draw, bar_left+24, by+bar_h//2-16, lang, jbb(28), BG)
    tr(draw, bar_right-20, by+bar_h//2-16, str(score), jbb(34), color)

# Callout box
cx = bar_right + 70

rro(draw, [cx, y, cx+cw_box, y+96], 10, SURFACE, MINT, 2)
tml(draw, cx+cw_box//2, y+10, [

db_chart_w = 820

def draw_db_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):

        cdraw.rectangle([gx, int(db_mt*scale),

        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(22*scale)))

        for i in range(len(pts)-1):

        dr = slw//2 + int(2*scale)
        for px, py in pts:
            cdraw.ellipse([px-dr, py-dr, px+dr, py+dr], fill=color)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Master Poster Generator.

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering for anti-aliased precision.
Every element meticulously calibrated for museum-grade execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SETUP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

W, H = 3508, 4961  # A1 portrait at 150 DPI

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):

def tb(draw, txt, font):

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=60, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px, py, px+ds, py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def thick_line(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Draw an anti-aliased-ish thick line by drawing a polygon."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if length < 0.5:
        r = width/2
        draw.ellipse([x0-r, y0-r, x0+r, y0+r], fill=fill)
        return
    nx = -dy / length * (width/2)
    ny = dx / length * (width/2)
    corners = [
        (x0+nx, y0+ny), (x1+nx, y1+ny),
        (x1-nx, y1-ny), (x0-nx, y0-ny),
    ]
    draw.polygon([(int(c[0]), int(c[1])) for c in corners], fill=fill)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Master Poster Generator.

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering for anti-aliased precision.
Every element meticulously calibrated for museum-grade execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SETUP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

W, H = 3508, 4961  # A1 portrait at 150 DPI

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"

MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=60, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px, py, px+ds, py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def thick_line(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Draw an anti-aliased-ish thick line by drawing a polygon."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if length < 0.5:
        r = width/2
        draw.ellipse([x0-r, y0-r, x0+r, y0+r], fill=fill)
        return
    nx = -dy / length * (width/2)
    ny = dx / length * (width/2)
    corners = [
        (x0+nx, y0+ny), (x1+nx, y1+ny),
        (x1-nx, y1-ny), (x0-nx, y0-ny),
    ]
    draw.polygon([(int(c[0]), int(c[1])) for c in corners], fill=fill)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPER-SAMPLED CHART RENDERING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    """Render chart at scale*x, downsample with LANCZOS for anti-aliasing."""
    sw, sh = int(chart_w * scale), int(chart_h * scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw, sh), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+450, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-32, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(100), BLUE)

y += 118
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(44), WHITE)

y += 62
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+180, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
# Small diamond
cx = MX + 168
draw.polygon([(cx, y+8), (cx+7, y+16), (cx, y+24), (cx-7, y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 75
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90) // 4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx, y, bx+badge_w, y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(38 if len(value) < 9 else 30)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 110


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017–2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 90, 180, 40, 60
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb
SUPERSAMPLE = 2

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    """Draw the language trajectory chart at supersampled resolution."""
    # Chart background
    rr(cdraw, [0, 0, cw, ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid
    for pct in [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70]:
        gy_frac = pct / 70.0
        gy = int((chart_mt + plot_h - gy_frac * plot_h) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([int(chart_ml*scale), gy,
                         int((chart_ml+plot_w)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(22*scale)))
        cdraw.text((int((chart_ml-16)*scale) - tw, gy - int(7*scale)),
                   label, font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # X-axis
    for yr in [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]:
        xf = (yr - 2017) / 7.0
        gx = int((chart_ml + xf * plot_w) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([gx, int(chart_mt*scale),
                         gx+max(1,int(scale)), int((chart_mt+plot_h)*scale)],
                        fill=GRID_LN)
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(24*scale)))
        cdraw.text((gx - tw//2, int((chart_mt+plot_h+20)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(24*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # Data series
    all_series = [
        # Secondary (behind)
        ([(0,60),(2,61),(4,60),(6,52),(7,51)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,42),(2,56),(4,54),(6,52),(7,48)], "#3b4261", 2.5, False),
        ([(0,47),(2,50),(4,49),(6,49),(7,46)], "#414868", 2.5, False),
        ([(2,6),(4,8),(6,7),(7,8)],           "#4a3f5e", 2.0, False),
        ([(0,17),(2,20),(4,23),(6,18),(7,17)], "#3b4261", 2.0, False),
        # Primary (on top)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Master Poster Generator.

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering for anti-aliased precision.
Every element meticulously calibrated for museum-grade execution.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SETUP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

W, H = 3508, 4961  # A1 portrait at 150 DPI

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"

MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAWING HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0+2*r, y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y0, x1, y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0, y1-2*r, x0+2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r, y1-2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r, y0, x1-r, y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0, y0+r, x1, y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=60, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px, py, px+ds, py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def thick_line(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Draw an anti-aliased-ish thick line by drawing a polygon."""
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
    if length < 0.5:
        r = width/2
        draw.ellipse([x0-r, y0-r, x0+r, y0+r], fill=fill)
        return
    nx = -dy / length * (width/2)
    ny = dx / length * (width/2)
    corners = [
        (x0+nx, y0+ny), (x1+nx, y1+ny),
        (x1-nx, y1-ny), (x0-nx, y0-ny),
    ]
    draw.polygon([(int(c[0]), int(c[1])) for c in corners], fill=fill)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SUPER-SAMPLED CHART RENDERING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    """Render chart at scale*x, downsample with LANCZOS for anti-aliasing."""
    sw, sh = int(chart_w * scale), int(chart_h * scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw, sh), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+450, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-32, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(100), BLUE)

y += 118
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(44), WHITE)

y += 62
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+180, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
# Small diamond
cx = MX + 168
draw.polygon([(cx, y+8), (cx+7, y+16), (cx, y+24), (cx-7, y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 75
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90) // 4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx, y, bx+badge_w, y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(38 if len(value) < 9 else 30)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 110


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017–2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 90

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 90, 180, 40, 60
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb
SUPERSAMPLE = 2

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    """Draw the language trajectory chart at supersampled resolution."""
    # Chart background
    rr(cdraw, [0, 0, cw, ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid
    for pct in [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70]:
        gy_frac = pct / 70.0

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"

CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"
RULE     = "#21243a"
MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ── Drawing helpers ─────────────────────────────────────

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x,y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=80, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):

    cdraw.line([(x0,y0),(x1,y1)], fill=fill, width=max(1, int(width)))

    draw.rectangle([MX, y, W-MX, y+1], fill=RULE)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Refined Poster (v3).

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering. Every element calibrated.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"
RULE     = "#21243a"
MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ── Drawing helpers ─────────────────────────────────────

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x,y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=80, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px,py,px+ds,py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def smooth_line(cdraw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Use Pillow's native line drawing with width param."""
    cdraw.line([(x0,y0),(x1,y1)], fill=fill, width=max(1, int(width)))

def section_rule(draw, y):
    """Subtle horizontal rule between major sections."""
    draw.rectangle([MX, y, W-MX, y+1], fill=RULE)

# ── Supersampled chart renderer ─────────────────────────

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    sw, sh = int(chart_w*scale), int(chart_h*scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw,sh), (0,0,0,0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

SUPERSAMPLE = 2

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line — luminous blue
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+500, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-34, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(104), BLUE)

y += 122
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(46), WHITE)

y += 66
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+184, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
cx = MX + 172
draw.polygon([(cx,y+8),(cx+7,y+16),(cx,y+24),(cx-7,y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 78
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90)//4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx,y,bx+badge_w,y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(40 if len(value)<9 else 32)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 115


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
section_rule(draw, y-20)

t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017 to 2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 92

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 95, 175, 40, 65
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    rr(cdraw, [0,0,cw,ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid + labels
    for pct in range(0, 75, 10):
        gy = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (pct/70.0)*plot_h) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle(
            [int(chart_ml*scale), gy, int((chart_ml+plot_w)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
            fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(22*scale)))
        cdraw.text((int((chart_ml-18)*scale)-tw, gy-int(7*scale)),
                   label, font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # X-axis grid + labels
    for yr in [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]:
        xf = (yr-2017)/7.0
        gx = int((chart_ml + xf*plot_w)*scale)
        cdraw.rectangle(
            [gx, int(chart_mt*scale), gx+max(1,int(scale)), int((chart_mt+plot_h)*scale)],
            fill=GRID_LN)
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(24*scale)))
        cdraw.text((gx-tw//2, int((chart_mt+plot_h+22)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(24*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # Data series — secondary behind, primary on top
    all_series = [
        ([(0,60),(2,61),(4,60),(6,52),(7,51)], "#3b4261", 3.0),
        ([(0,42),(2,56),(4,54),(6,52),(7,48)], "#3b4261", 3.0),
        ([(0,47),(2,50),(4,49),(6,49),(7,46)], "#414868", 3.0),
        ([(2,6), (4,8), (6,7), (7,8)],          "#4a3f5e", 2.5),
        ([(0,17),(2,20),(4,23),(6,18),(7,17)], "#3b4261", 2.5),
        ([(0,65),(2,69),(4,69),(6,61),(7,61)], BLUE,  5.5),
        ([(0,32),(2,49),(4,52),(6,54),(7,57)], AMBER, 5.0),
        ([(0,12),(2,25),(4,29),(6,34),(7,37)], MINT,  5.5),
    ]

    for data, color, lw in all_series:
        pts = []
        for yr_idx, val in data:
            px = int((chart_ml + (yr_idx/7.0)*plot_w)*scale)
            py = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (val/70.0)*plot_h)*scale)
            pts.append((px, py))

        slw = lw * scale
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            smooth_line(cdraw, pts[i][0], pts[i][1], pts[i+1][0], pts[i+1][1], slw, color)

        dot_r = slw/2 + 2*scale
        for px, py in pts:
            cdraw.ellipse([px-dot_r, py-dot_r, px+dot_r, py+dot_r], fill=color)

    # Legend
    legend_data = [
        ("JavaScript", BLUE,  61, 5.5),
        ("Python",     AMBER, 57, 5.0),
        ("TypeScript", MINT,  37, 5.5),
    ]
    leg_y = int((chart_mt+30)*scale)
    leg_x = int((chart_ml+plot_w+30)*scale)
    for i, (name, color, fv, lw) in enumerate(legend_data):
        ly = leg_y + i*int(85*scale)
        slw = int(lw*scale)
        cdraw.rectangle([leg_x, ly, leg_x+int(40*scale), ly+slw], fill=color)
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly-int(3*scale)),
                   name, font=isb(int(26*scale)), fill=color, anchor="lt")
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly+int(24*scale)),
                   f"{fv}%", font=isr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

chart_img = render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, SUPERSAMPLE, draw_trajectory_chart)
img.paste(chart_img, (MX-10, y-15), chart_img)

y += chart_h + 85


# ── SECTION 3: PROMISE INDEX ─────────────────────────────
section_rule(draw, y-25)

t(draw, MX, y-20, "03", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "THE LANGUAGE PROMISE INDEX", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+40, "Combining growth, retention & adoption intent to forecast ecosystem direction",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 92

promise_data = [
    ("TypeScript", 199, MINT),
    ("Rust",       198, CORAL),
    ("Python",     151, AMBER),
    ("Go",         129, BLUE),
    ("Lua",        118, "#787c99"),
    ("C++",        113, "#787c99"),
    ("Kotlin",     113, "#787c99"),
]
bar_left = MX
bar_right = MX + int(CW*0.62)
bar_h, bar_gap = 50, 18
max_score = 220

for i, (lang, score, color) in enumerate(promise_data):
    by = y + i*(bar_h+bar_gap)
    bar_w = int((score/max_score)*(bar_right-bar_left))
    rr(draw, [bar_left, by, bar_right, by+bar_h], 8, SURFACE)
    if bar_w > 12:
        rr(draw, [bar_left, by, bar_left+bar_w, by+bar_h], 8, color)
    t(draw, bar_left+26, by+bar_h//2-16, lang, jbb(28), BG)
    tr(draw, bar_right-22, by+bar_h//2-16, str(score), jbb(36), color)

# Callout box
cx = bar_right + 70
cw_box = W - MX - cx
rro(draw, [cx, y, cx+cw_box, y+100], 10, SURFACE, MINT, 2)
tml(draw, cx+cw_box//2, y+12, [
    "TypeScript at 199",
    "signals where the",
    "ecosystem is heading —",
    "not just where it's been."

y += len(promise_data)*(bar_h+bar_gap) + 105


# ── SECTION 4: DATABASES ─────────────────────────────────

t(draw, MX, y-20, "04", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "DATABASES: OPEN-SOURCE DOMINANCE", jbb(32), BLUE)

  isr(24), DIM)
y += 92

db_chart_w = 820

db_series_data = [
    ("MySQL",      [(0,60),(3,52),(5,52)], BLUE,  4.0),
    ("PostgreSQL", [(0,32),(3,38),(5,45)], AMBER, 5.0),
    ("MongoDB",    [(0,30),(3,27),(5,30)], MINT,  3.5),
    ("SQLite",     [(0,29),(3,27),(5,30)], CORAL, 3.5),
    ("Redis",      [(0,22),(3,18),(5,20)], "#787c99", 3.0),

        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(20*scale)))

        gx = int((db_ml + xf*plot_w_db)*scale)

            fill=GRID_LN)

        cdraw.text((gx-tw//2, int((db_mt+plot_h_db+24)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

t(draw, MX+74, y+32, "18%", jbb(110), CORAL)
t(draw, MX+295, y+46, "of developers now build", isb(40), WHITE)

# Bottom accent
draw.rectangle([MX, footer_y-62, W-MX, footer_y-60], fill=BLUE)

t(draw, MX, footer_y-22, "Source: JetBrains State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", isr(28), DIM)

  "Design language: Spectral Index — A visual philosophy for calibrated data communication",

output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Refined Poster (v3).

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering. Every element calibrated.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"
RULE     = "#21243a"
MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ── Drawing helpers ─────────────────────────────────────

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x,y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y1-2*r,x1,y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0+r,y0,x1-r,y1], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x0,y0+r,x1,y1-r], fill=fill)

def rro(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline, width):
    rr(draw, xy, radius, outline)
    inner = [xy[0]+width, xy[1]+width, xy[2]-width, xy[3]-width]
    rr(draw, inner, max(0, radius-width), fill)

def dot_grid(draw, x0, y0, x1, y1, spacing=80, ds=2):
    for px in range(x0, x1, spacing):
        for py in range(y0, y1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([px,py,px+ds,py+ds], fill=DOTCOLOR)

def smooth_line(cdraw, x0, y0, x1, y1, width, fill):
    """Use Pillow's native line drawing with width param."""
    cdraw.line([(x0,y0),(x1,y1)], fill=fill, width=max(1, int(width)))

def section_rule(draw, y):
    """Subtle horizontal rule between major sections."""
    draw.rectangle([MX, y, W-MX, y+1], fill=RULE)

# ── Supersampled chart renderer ─────────────────────────

def render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, scale, draw_fn):
    sw, sh = int(chart_w*scale), int(chart_h*scale)
    canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (sw,sh), (0,0,0,0))
    cdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    draw_fn(cdraw, sw, sh, scale)
    return canvas.resize((chart_w, chart_h), Image.LANCZOS)

SUPERSAMPLE = 2

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

img = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle dot-grid background
dot_grid(draw, 0, 0, W, H, spacing=80, ds=2)


# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ────────────────────────────────────
y = 150

# Top accent line — luminous blue
draw.rectangle([MX, y-4, W-MX, y-2], fill=BLUE)
draw.rectangle([MX, y-2, MX+500, y], fill=BLUE)

# Section number
t(draw, MX, y-34, "01", jbr(18), DIM)

# Title
t(draw, MX, y, "State of Developer Ecosystem 2024", jbb(104), BLUE)

y += 122
t(draw, MX, y, "LANGUAGE WARS & RISING STARS", jbb(46), WHITE)

y += 66
t(draw, MX, y, "Survey of", isr(30), DIM)
t(draw, MX+184, y, "23,262 developers worldwide", isb(30), WHITE)
cx = MX + 172
draw.polygon([(cx,y+8),(cx+7,y+16),(cx,y+24),(cx-7,y+16)], fill=DIM)

y += 78
# Stat badges
badge_w = (CW - 90)//4
badge_h = 94
bx = MX
for label, value, color in [
    ("JavaScript",  "61%",      BLUE),
    ("Python",      "57%",      AMBER),
    ("TypeScript",  "12 → 37%", MINT),
    ("AI Adoption", "18%",      CORAL),
]:
    rr(draw, [bx,y,bx+badge_w,y+badge_h], 10, SURFACE)
    vf = jbb(40 if len(value)<9 else 32)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+31, value, vf, color)
    tm(draw, bx+badge_w//2, y+70, label, isr(20), DIM)
    bx += badge_w + 30

y += badge_h + 115


# ── SECTION 2: LANGUAGE TRAJECTORY (CENTERPIECE) ──────────
section_rule(draw, y-20)

t(draw, MX, y-20, "02", jbr(18), DIM)
t(draw, MX, y, "TOP PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES: 8-YEAR TRAJECTORY", jbb(32), BLUE)
t(draw, MX, y+38, "How developer usage shifted across the most-used languages, 2017 to 2024",
  isr(24), DIM)
y += 92

chart_w = CW - 40
chart_h = 1280
chart_ml, chart_mr, chart_mt, chart_mb = 95, 175, 40, 65
plot_w = chart_w - chart_ml - chart_mr
plot_h = chart_h - chart_mt - chart_mb

def draw_trajectory_chart(cdraw, cw, ch, scale):
    rr(cdraw, [0,0,cw,ch], int(12*scale), SURFACE)

    # Y-axis grid + labels
    for pct in range(0, 75, 10):
        gy = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (pct/70.0)*plot_h) * scale)
        cdraw.rectangle(
            [int(chart_ml*scale), gy, int((chart_ml+plot_w)*scale), gy+max(1,int(scale))],
            fill=GRID_LN)
        label = f"{pct}%"
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, label, jbr(int(22*scale)))
        cdraw.text((int((chart_ml-18)*scale)-tw, gy-int(7*scale)),
                   label, font=jbr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # X-axis grid + labels
    for yr in [2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024]:
        xf = (yr-2017)/7.0
        gx = int((chart_ml + xf*plot_w)*scale)
        cdraw.rectangle(
            [gx, int(chart_mt*scale), gx+max(1,int(scale)), int((chart_mt+plot_h)*scale)],
            fill=GRID_LN)
        tw, _ = tb(cdraw, str(yr), jbr(int(24*scale)))
        cdraw.text((gx-tw//2, int((chart_mt+plot_h+22)*scale)),
                   str(yr), font=jbr(int(24*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

    # Data series — secondary behind, primary on top
    all_series = [

        ([(2,6), (4,8), (6,7), (7,8)],          "#4a3f5e", 2.5),
        ([(0,17),(2,20),(4,23),(6,18),(7,17)], "#3b4261", 2.5),
        ([(0,65),(2,69),(4,69),(6,61),(7,61)], BLUE,  5.5),
        ([(0,32),(2,49),(4,52),(6,54),(7,57)], AMBER, 5.0),
        ([(0,12),(2,25),(4,29),(6,34),(7,37)], MINT,  5.5),
    ]

    for data, color, lw in all_series:
        pts = []
        for yr_idx, val in data:

            py = int((chart_mt + plot_h - (val/70.0)*plot_h)*scale)
            pts.append((px, py))

        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            smooth_line(cdraw, pts[i][0], pts[i][1], pts[i+1][0], pts[i+1][1], slw, color)

        dot_r = slw/2 + 2*scale
        for px, py in pts:
            cdraw.ellipse([px-dot_r, py-dot_r, px+dot_r, py+dot_r], fill=color)

        ("JavaScript", BLUE,  61, 5.5),

        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly-int(3*scale)),
                   name, font=isb(int(26*scale)), fill=color, anchor="lt")
        cdraw.text((leg_x+int(55*scale), ly+int(24*scale)),
                   f"{fv}%", font=isr(int(22*scale)), fill=DIM, anchor="lt")

chart_img = render_chart_supersampled(chart_w, chart_h, SUPERSAMPLE, draw_trajectory_chart)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""State of Developer Ecosystem 2024 — Refined Poster (v3).

Spectral Index philosophy: luminous data against dark silence.
Supersampled chart rendering. Every element calibrated.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

W, H = 3508, 4961

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

jbr = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", s)
jbb = lambda s: load_font("JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf", s)
isr = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", s)
isb = lambda s: load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", s)

# Colors
BG       = "#1a1b26"
BLUE     = "#7aa2f7"
AMBER    = "#e0af68"
MINT     = "#9ece6a"
CORAL    = "#f7768e"
WHITE    = "#c0caf5"
DIM      = "#565f89"
GRID_LN  = "#24283b"
SURFACE  = "#1f2335"
DOTCOLOR = "#1e2130"
RULE     = "#21243a"
MX = 160
CW = W - 2 * MX

# ── Drawing helpers ─────────────────────────────────────

def tb(draw, txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2]-b[0], b[3]-b[1]

def t(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    draw.text((x,y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tc(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tr(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, _ = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw, y), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tm(draw, x, y, txt, font, fill=WHITE):
    tw, th = tb(draw, txt, font)
    draw.text((x-tw//2, y-th//2), txt, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")

def tml(draw, x, y, lines, font, fill=WHITE, ls=4):
    for line in lines:
        tw, lh = tb(draw, line, font)
        draw.text((x-tw//2, y), line, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="lt")
        y += lh + ls

def rr(draw, xy, radius, fill):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.pieslice([x0,y0,x0+2*r,y0+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1-2*r,y0,x1,y0+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x0,y1-2*r,x0+2*r,y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
